answer: Identity-bond decay stops fake identities. An agent locks a 50-unit jade bond that decays 5% each epoch unless verified work renews it; renewal needs work, not re-registration. The pool is an oasis reached by one narrow jetty, where each bond is checked and recorded. Creating 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 units plus top-ups, while an honest agent pays 50 once and recovers it in undiluted rewards within 20 epochs, so forgery costs more than it earns.
